instruction: Take a straw from the drawer in front and place it inside the glass cup on the dining counter.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: the drawer is pulled fully open (out to the end of its travel).
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the drawer is still closed or only partly open.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: the straw stands in the glass cup on the dining counter and the robot has let go of it and moved its gripper away (about 25 cm or more).
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the straw is still in the drawer, still held, lying next to the cup, or the gripper is still at the straw.
